excerpts.anchor: More than 95% of intracellular magnesium is bound to ATP
marks: magnesium serves as a cofactor in over 600 enzymatic reactions and may act as an activator for an additional 200 enzymes

excerpts.anchor: Most of the ATP within cells is found as Mg-ATP complexes
marks: Most of the ATP within cells is found as Mg-ATP complexes, representing its biologically active form
Magnesium is crucial for catalyzing all reactions involving ATP
